name: [Katagami] Temper is unreachable — real users are locked out
message:
Valid bearers are being rejected because the liveness checks behind them cannot run — Temper is unreachable, not the caller's fault. Every authenticated MCP user is locked out while this lasts.

Without this reason these would sit in the same bucket as garbage tokens and read as a probing spike, so treat it as an outage and not as abuse.

Check the Railway openpaw service first.

Logs: https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=service%3Akatagami-server%20env%3Aproduction%20%40reason%3Abackend_unavailable
